description: List all organizations publishing datasets on Data.gov. Returns organization names and dataset counts. Useful for discovering data publishers.
name: list_organizations

dataset_count.description: Number of datasets published by this organization

organization_type.description: e.g. "Federal Government", "State Government". Absent when the upstream omits it.

source_count.description: Number of harvest sources feeding this organization.

total.description: Total organizations the upstream reports, independent of how many were returned.

title: List Organizations
